sentences.text:
Sonu Varma, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 25 September,
2020

Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.4116 Of 2020
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C to quash the F.I.R No.296 of 2020 on the file of Gangavaram Police Station, Chittoor District, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 270,
273, 328, r/w 34 IPC, Section 24(1) r/w 27 of the COTP Act, Section 3 of the Epidemic Disease Act,
Section 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Section 4 of the Gutkha Pan Masala Prohibition Act.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.
3.

Though the petitioner raised several contentions in the petition, during the hearing, learned counsel for the petitioners and the Additional Public Prosecutor fairly conceded that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by an earlier order passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

4. Recording the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioners and the Additional Public Prosecutor, this Criminal Petition is allowed quashing the F.I.R No.296 of 2020 on the file of Gangavaram Police Station, Chittoor District in terms of the orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.
5.
Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall also stand closed.

JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date: 25.09.2020 AKN THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION NO.4116 OF 2020 Date: 25.09.2020 AKN Sonu Varma, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 25 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193695784/
